headline: Approved invoices, change orders, insurance agreements, a donation, and a budget amendment for a staff position.
summary: The board approved payment of several invoices including MVES, Massachusetts NAHRO Insurance Group, and Malden Police Department. It authorized change orders for Deiulis Brothers Construction and South Coast Improvement Company, a National Grid service agreement, and a State Property Insurance Participation Agreement. The board also approved a $750.00 donation to Mass Union of Public Housing Tenants and confirmed a budget amendment for the Modernization and Procurement Director position.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 1-27-26 meeting.
Approved payment of $20,902.84 to MVES for Resident Service Coordinators for December 2025.
Approved payment of $139,096.00 to Massachusetts NAHRO Insurance Group for Workmen's Compensation coverage renewal.
Approved payment of four Malden Police Department invoices totaling $2,361.73.
Approved change orders up to $250,000.00 for Deiulis Brothers Construction on the Forestdale ModPhase project.
Approved change orders up to $150,000.00 for South Coast Improvement Company on the Suffolk Manor stove electrification project.
Approved the National Grid Electric Service Agreement for Forestdale-667-1, with MHA paying $10,808.51.
Approved and authorized signing of the EOHLC State-Aided Property Insurance Participation Agreement dated December 16, 2025.
Approved a $750.00 donation to Mass Union of Public Housing Tenants for dual sponsorship.

Confirmed a previous approval to amend the FY2026 budget for the open Modernization and Procurement position, raising pay from $120,000.00 to $130,000.00 per year and adding a $500.00 per month car allowance.

decision_evidence.quote: To approve and authorize payment in the amount of $20,902.84 from MVES for Resident Service Coordinators for the month of December 2025 with costs paid by the AMP's served.
To approve and authorize payment in the amount of $139,096.00 to Massachusetts NAHRO Insurance Group for renewal of MHA's Workmen's Compensation coverage as detailed above.
To approve payment of four (4) invoices from the Malden Police Department totaling $2,361.73 as detailed above with cost to be paid by the AMP's served.
To approve and authorize expected change orders in the amount up to $250,000.00 as detailed above from DEIULIS for work on the Forestdale ModPhase Project with cost paid by the State through CapHub.
To approve and authorize change orders in the amount up to $150,000.00 as detailed above from South Coast Improvement Company with cost paid by the CFP.

To approve and authorize the National Grid Electric Service Agreement for Forestdale-667-1 with MHA paying $10,808.51 with cost to be allocated either to the State program or COCC 2 with the granting of a new Easement and execution of related agreements.
To approve and authorize the Board Chairperson and Executive Director to sign and submit the EOHLC State-Aided Property Insurance Participation Agreement dated December 16, 2025 as detailed above.

To approve and authorize donation in the amount of $750.00 to Mass Union of Public Housing Tenants for dual sponsorship of Public Housing Day (4-16-26) and Annual Convention (10-2-26 through 10-4-26) with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.

To confirm the previous approval to amend FY2026 budget for the open Modernization and Procurement position from $120,000.00 to $130,000.00 per year and to add a $500.00 per month car allowance stipend.
